question: In the underground gas storage cycles, by how much did extraction at the lower pressure limit of the second cycle raise the crude oil recovery?
rendered:
Document 11: "Phase Behavior and Mass Transfer During Oil Reservoir Conversion to Underground Gas Storage: Effects on Storage Capacity and Recovery Efficiency"

"According to Figure 14, the extraction at the lower pressure limit of the first cycle (20 MPa) increases the crude oil recovery rate by 3.68%, much smaller than that of the second cycle (6.93%)."
